as_told.title: Blue Book special unit investigated 700 unexplained sightings

plain: While Project Blue Book, the US Air Force's UFO study of the 1950s and 60s, told the public that sightings were swamp gas or birds, a special unit inside it was quietly looking at more than 700 real, unexplained sightings. The lawyer Dan Sheehan tells this, in one episode saying a man named Oscar Wolf told him he worked directly with Blue Book, and in another naming his source as Albert Stein, an Army clerk typist assigned to the project. If true, it would mean the public explanations were a cover while real cases were studied in secret.
